page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9h.2xlarge is a compute-optimized instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and utilizes an 8-core dedicated Hygon 7447v processor clocked at 2.6 GHz. System memory totals 16.0 GB, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per core to support compute-focused processing requirements without over-allocating system memory.

Hardware acceleration is not included, with GPU allocation remaining at zero. The configuration includes no local storage, requiring external network-attached volumes for the operating system and persistent data storage. Networking capabilities feature a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned to the instance.

Given its dedicated resource allocation, the ecs.c9h.2xlarge provides consistent CPU performance for compute-centric workloads that do not require massive in-memory caching or high-capacity local disk IOPS. Suitable use cases include containerized microservices, web application tiers, batch data processing, and CI/CD compilation tasks.
